observations: Photos show a set of used tires stacked (appears to be 4 tires).
Tread blocks look present but there is visible wear and some uneven/aged-looking surface texture.
Photo 2 shows the tires laid side-by-side; no clear tire size/brand/model markings are readable.
No wheel/rim details are clearly shown; only one wheel edge is partially visible in photo 2, but the tire-to-wheel pairing is not clear.

claims.evidence: No photo shows country-of-origin markings, DOT codes, or any label proving Belgium origin; wheels are not clearly shown as a complete set.

risks.risk: Tire size/fitment is unknown (could be wrong for the buyer’s car).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the tire sidewall showing size (e.g., 205/55R16) and load/speed rating.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used tires with unknown fitment (worst-case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Tread depth and condition are uncertain (could be near end-of-life).
risks.proof: A photo of tread depth measurement (tread gauge) at multiple points, or a close-up showing remaining tread clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn used tires (worst-case: low remaining tread).

risks.risk: Age/production year is unknown (DOT week/year not readable).
risks.proof: Close-up of the DOT code on each tire sidewall (week/year).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older used tires (worst-case: older rubber).

risks.risk: Whether wheels/rims are included is unclear.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full wheel set (all rims) and that the tires are mounted on them (or a clear statement + photos of rims separately).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tires only (worst-case: no wheels included).

risks.risk: Damage/repairs (cuts, bulges, patches) not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Photos of each tire’s full sidewall and tread from multiple angles, including any suspected damage areas.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tires with possible minor issues (worst-case: not guaranteed damage-free).

proof_requests: Clear sidewall close-ups for each tire showing: tire size, load/speed rating, and DOT week/year.
Tread depth measurements (or very clear tread close-ups) for each tire at 3–4 points.
Photos confirming whether wheels/rims are included: full set of rims and whether tires are mounted on them.
response.reason: From the photos, these appear to be used tires, but the key details that determine Abuja pricing (exact size/fitment, DOT age, tread depth, and whether wheels are included) are not readable or fully shown. Without that proof, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
